title: Lo Que Siento
lyrics:
[00:14.69]Dreaming of you when I'm alone
[00:18.45]Baby, don't trip, I'm coming home
[00:22.00]Kick it with me, I don't care if the sun is gone
[00:29.38]Baby, don't cry when I am gone
[00:33.14]Promise you're everything I want
[00:36.82]This is for you, baby, listen, it's your song
[00:43.66]Oye, cariño, solo pienso en ti
[00:47.56]When I wake up in the morning until I go back to sleep
[00:51.07]How I wish you were mine, I think of you all the time
[00:54.73]I always feel like I'm flying
[00:56.51]Baby, you make me feel fine
[00:58.87]Lost in the words that you say to me
[01:02.24]Y pasando tiempo juntos is the ultimate dream
[01:05.90]I'm on top of the world, baby girl, can't you see?
[01:09.29]I found my perfect girl, I wanna make you my queen
[01:13.30]Time and time again, I can be feeling real sad
[01:16.96]'Cause mi sueño no se ha hecho una realidad
[01:20.80]Pero el tiempo dirá, el tiempo dirá
[01:24.21]If we go spend our lives together en lo que el mundo gira
[01:28.47]I promise I don't want nobody else to be around me but you
[01:32.10]And nobody's touch and nobody's lips can make me feel like yours do
[01:35.62]Our hands interlock, nuestros labios se conocen
[01:39.21]Nuestra noche es corta, pero hermosa, we'll be okay
[01:43.21]Dreaming of you when I'm alone
[01:47.01]Baby, don't trip, I'm coming home
[01:50.70]Kick it with me, I don't care if the sun is gone
[01:58.11]Baby, don't cry when I am gone
[02:01.71]Promise you're everything I want
[02:05.45]This is for you, baby, listen, it's your song
[02:12.07]Sin ti mis días son largos y se sienten tan amargos
[02:16.30]Me ahogo en un lago, de mis lágrimas que hago
[02:19.82]Can't look forward to my future if it ain't including you
[02:23.50]Promise that I'm gonna love you, it's about that time you knew
[02:27.45]I swear I don't see nothing better than to lay here with you
[02:30.92]And I hope you know I miss you
[02:32.71]From my head, I can't dismiss you
[02:34.66]Eres lo que yo anhelaba en esta vida, que me falta
[02:38.30]Lo que siento is surreal, I can't lie to you for real
[02:42.36]Sabes bien que te quiero
[02:49.15]And if you're down to spend your summer with me, just let me know
[02:57.11]You know you're my sueño
[03:04.21]You came to life and now I feel alright
